content.text:
Draw ONE enemy sprite for the NES game Mega Man 2 (Capcom, 1988), in exactly the style of the reference sprites
shown (they are authentic Mega Man 2 enemies, enlarged).

The enemy: A small floating robot squid, Blooper-like, that swims along at and after Mega Man in pulses (tentacles gather, then thrust). It is a swimming mine: when it gets close its eyes flash red, then it explodes.
Deliver: the primary frame (glide pose, tentacles together), facing left.
True size: about 16x16 to 20x20 px.

Hard rules:
- Real NES pixel art: a grid of about 16-20 pixels each way, drawn enlarged so every pixel is a clean, equal-sized
  square block. No anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no texture, no dithering.
- Colours from the NES palette only: black plus at most 3 other colours. Flat colours with one highlight colour.
- Continuous 1-pixel black outline around the silhouette, used the Capcom way.
- Big readable shapes and a strong silhouette that reads at true size; cute, charming Capcom robot design.
- The sprite alone, centred, on a plain flat uniform grey-blue background (#606078). No text, no frame, no shadow,
  no scenery, no second sprite, no copy of the references.
